_comment: Journey definitions. Repo-derived content is referenced, not typed: {"$node":id} pulls text/chips from SMART_FLOW + CONDITION_NODES, {"$conditions":true} the 15 condition labels, {"$articleTitles":cat} the article titles of a KB category, {"$article":key} an article (see 'articles' below). Strings may use {{path}} from the build context (article.*, stats.*, cat.*). 'ui' items drive the User Journeys - UI page (chips attach to the previous bot message). 'low' items drive the lowfi page and are condensed, editorial text.

journeys.sub: Rigid, deterministic. Ends in an internal article.

journeys.name: Journey B — Ask MD Live
journeys.sub: Smart bridging, hand-scripted. Never auto-surfaces an article.

steps.title: B1 · Entry menu
low: 3 entry buttons — shared across all journeys

steps.title: B2 · wh-menopause
low: For perimenopause/menopause, an MDLIVE Primary Care doctor can build a plan — HRT, weight mgmt, mental health, sleep. Want prescription options?
↺ “Ask about my child’s care” → Branch · peds-bridge

steps.title: B3 · wh-prescriptions
low: Your doctor can send prescriptions to your pharmacy, incl. birth control. Want to know about GLP-1s?
↺ “Read the full article” → internal article viewer (A4 mechanic)

steps.title: B4 · wh-glp1
low: MDLIVE can prescribe GLP-1s (Wegovy, Zepbound) via Routine Care, state-dependent. Want cost details?

steps.title: B5 · wh-cost
low: Cost varies by plan — $0 copay possible, $59-$99 without insurance. Want insurance details?

steps.title: B6 · wh-insurance
low: HSA/FSA eligible; Medicaid/Medicare accepted in participating states. Anything else?

steps.title: B7 · closing
low: Glad I could help today — take care, and reach out anytime!
